note: Six PAR subsets each deliver DATUM and LOPDAT. Five deliveries of each leave Kopplingsvariabel blank (an explicit non-identifier claim); PAR_F marks both 'X' (an identifier claim), so each variable's identifier claim disagrees (#1662). A reviewed [[errata.field]] entry corrects identifier on DATUM's PAR_F occurrence to false, guarding the original's stated true: DATUM's six occurrences then agree and it is built as a non-identifier. LOPDAT has the same mixed claim and no entry, so its identifier reconciles to unknown and it stays withheld: nothing reconciles a disagreement silently. Kodlista_DATUM binds all six DATUM rows with one member of unknown validity, which only an identifier record clamps away without an issue; the corrected PAR_F row is no longer one, so it reports unknown_code_validity like its siblings.
fails_if: the `[[errata.field]]` loader refuses an `identifier` correction (the build fails curation load), its checked change stops reaching the outlier occurrence (datum withheld as unresolved_flag on is_identifier), a disagreeing identifier claim with no entry stops withholding its variable (lopdat built), or `bind_occurrence_code_lists` reads the uncorrected source flag instead of the occurrence's corrected identifier, so PAR_F keeps identifier leniency on its codes (no unknown_code_validity or unknown_code_membership for PAR_F's DATUM)
